title: Loan Officer
description:
This job is provided by apna.co Job Description – LAP SalesPosition: Sales Officer / Relationship Manager – LAP
   

  

 Department: Sales
   

  

 Product: Loan Against Property (LAP)
   

  

 Employment Type: Full\-Time
   

  

 Location: As per business requirement
   

  

 Experience: Freshers and experienced candidates can be considered
   

  

 About the RoleWe are looking for energetic and target\-oriented professionals to join our LAP Sales Team. The candidate will be responsible for generating new business, acquiring customers, building relationships, and achieving sales targets for Loan Against Property products.
   

  

 Key ResponsibilitiesGenerate leads and acquire new customers for LAP products.
   

  

 Identify potential customers through field visits, references, market activities, and other sourcing channels.
   

  

 Explain LAP products, eligibility, documentation, interest rates, and repayment terms to customers.
   

  

 Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, DSAs, connectors, brokers, and other business partners.
   

  

 Collect and verify required customer and property\-related documents.
   

  

 Coordinate with credit, operations, legal, technical, and other internal teams for smooth processing of applications.
   

  

 Follow up on leads and applications from sourcing to disbursement.
   

  

 Achieve monthly sales and business targets.
   

  

 Maintain regular market visits and develop a strong local customer network.
   

  

 Ensure compliance with company policies and processes.
   

  

 Track competitors and market trends and provide relevant feedback to the team.
   

  

 Candidate ProfileGraduate in any discipline.
   

  

 MBA/PGDM in Sales or Marketing will be an added advantage.
   

  

 Freshers with good communication and sales aptitude can apply.
   

  

 Candidates with experience in LAP, Home Loans, Mortgage, Banking, NBFC, or financial services will be preferred.
   

  

 Good communication and interpersonal skills.
   

  

 Strong customer\-handling and negotiation abilities.
   

  

 Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory.
   

  

 Target\-oriented and self\-motivated approach.
   

  

 Two\-wheeler and a valid driving licence may be preferred, depending on the location and role requirements.
   

  

 Key SkillsSales \& Business Development
   

  

 Lead Generation
   

  

 Customer Acquisition
   

  

 Relationship Management
   

  

 Field Sales
   

  

 Negotiation Skills
   

  

 Communication Skills
   

  

 Market Mapping
   

  

 Target Achievement
   

  

 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)New customer acquisition
   

  

 Monthly LAP disbursement/business
   

  

 Lead conversion
   

  

 Number of applications sourced
   

  

 Customer and channel partner acquisition
   

  

 Portfolio quality and process compliance
   

  

 Achievement of assigned sales targets
   

  

 CompensationSalary: As per company norms and candidate experience
   

  

 Incentives: Performance\-based incentives applicable as per company policy.
   

  

 Career OpportunityThe role provides an opportunity to build a career in Retail Lending, Mortgage Sales, Business Development, and Relationship Management, with growth opportunities based on performance and experience.

title: Commission Sales Associate
company: SB AIRCON HEAT AND FLOW SOLUTIONS
description:
**Company Description** 
 SB AIRCON HEAT AND FLOW SOLUTIONS specializes in complete air conditioning and ventilation services for the construction industry, including advanced CFD simulations. The company provides end\-to\-end engineering services covering mechanical product development, CAE, CFD and thermal analysis, and design optimization. It also delivers customized HVAC solutions and manufacturing engineering support to meet diverse project requirements. Team members work closely with clients to ensure efficient, reliable, and cost\-effective environmental and mechanical systems for buildings.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Commission Sales Associate role based in Dodda Ballapur. The Commission Sales Associate will identify and pursue new business opportunities for air conditioning, ventilation, HVAC, and engineering services, focusing on construction and industrial clients. Daily responsibilities include generating leads, conducting site visits, presenting solutions, preparing quotations, and following up to close sales. The role involves building long\-term relationships with customers, coordinating with technical teams to align proposals with project requirements, and maintaining accurate sales records. The individual will also monitor market trends, support marketing activities, and contribute to meeting revenue targets through commission\-based sales.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong sales, negotiation, and customer relationship skills, with the ability to identify client needs and present suitable solutions.
* Basic understanding of HVAC systems, air conditioning, ventilation, and engineering services, with willingness to learn technical details.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills, including the ability to interact professionally with contractors, engineers, and project managers.
* Good organizational and time\-management skills, with the ability to handle multiple inquiries, site visits, and follow\-ups.
* Comfortable working in an on\-site environment in Dodda Ballapur and visiting client locations as needed.
* Prior experience in field sales, construction\-related sales, or industrial equipment sales is an advantage.
* Proficiency with basic office software (e.g., email, spreadsheets, presentations) for quotations and reporting.
* Minimum of a high school diploma; a degree or diploma in engineering, business, or a related field is beneficial.
* Self\-motivated, target\-oriented, and able to work independently while collaborating effectively with internal teams.
